关于：一名日本军官在四川北路靠近吴昌路处被一名身份不明的中国男子枪击并受致命伤一事之进一步报告。

侦探在枪击现场进行的进一步调查，于1940年9月30日找到了两名小贩，一男一女，分别名为顾芝荣（Koo Ts Yoong），居住于四川北路506弄680号，以及方朱氏（Fong Ts Sz），居住于四川北路506弄15号。枪击发生时，他们正在四川北路560弄口售卖香烟，该弄堂位于四川北路东侧，正对发生枪击案的吴昌路。除这两名证人外，侦探还找到了一名中国更夫洪德元（Hung Tah Yuen），居住于海宁路621号。枪击发生时，他正在值班并巡逻上述弄堂，听到两声枪响后，他从弄堂跑至四川北路，并向警方陈述了当时在枪击现场所观察到的情况。已获取上述所有人员的书面供词，附于文后。从上述所有证人的供词中得知，1940年9月29日晚10时许，当这名现已死亡的日本军官沿四川北

was removed to the hospital in a m/car. No one of the
above witnesses was able to state who fired the shots and
it appears that the person who did it was standing in a
shade at the side of Woochang Road, west of N. Szechuen
Road and which location is very poorly lighted (no street
lights).

（批：Depend on the shops situated at the corner, where the shooting occurred, for the lighting）

Further enquiries made by D.S.I. Watanabe at
Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters learned that the fatally
wounded officer was Major Y. Isobe, Japanese Air Force,
who as already mentioned in previous diary arrived to
Shanghai from Nanking on the morning of the 29-9-40, i.e.
the same day when the shooting occurred, and was stationed
at the "New Asia" Hotel, N. Szechuen Road and who at about
10 p.m. 29-9-40, arrived on m/car from somewhere in Hong-
kew District to N. Szechuen Road and Boone Road corner to
buy books but on finding that the shop was already closed
walked on his feet south along west side of N. Szechuen
Road with intention to proceed to the "New Asia" Hotel
when on approaching Japanese Gendarmerie canteen situated
pages.zh:
3/2

路吴昌路路口西侧人行道行进时，被一名身份不明的人向其开了两枪，死者中弹受伤，但仍能沿四川北路向北行走约100码，到达吴昌路以北处。此时，一队来自距离枪击现场约200码的宪兵队总部的日本宪兵赶到，他随即倒地，并被用汽车送往医院。上述证人中无人能指出是谁开的枪，看来开枪者站在四川北路以西、吴昌路路边的阴影处，该地点光线极差（无路灯）。

（批：取决于枪击发生处拐角店铺的照明情况）

渡边（Watanabe）警探在日本宪兵队总部进行的进一步调查获悉，受致命伤的军官是日本空军少校矶部（Y. Isobe）。如前日记所述，他于1940年9月29日（即枪击发生当天）上午从南京抵达上海，驻扎于四川北路的“新亚”酒店。1940年9月29日晚10时许，他乘汽车从虹口区某地来到四川北路与蓬路（Boone Road）路口欲购买书籍，但发现店铺已关门，便步行沿四川北路西侧向南，打算前往“新亚”酒店。当他走近位于

pages.en:
3/3

on the south-west corner of N. Szechuen and Woochang
roads intersection some one fired two shots at his back,
one bullet came out penetrating his stomach and the other
penetrated his left chest. The injured officer had been
at first removed to Shinojaki Hospital, Boone Road and
then dispatched to the Japanese Army field hospital,
Y'poo Road, where he died from his injuries at 10.50 p.m.
29-3-40. According to enquiries made by D.S.I. Tatanabe
at Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, it was learned
that 10 persons were detained and questioned in connec-
tion with this shooting, 8 of whom were released after
questioning but 2 Chinese hawkers being still detained
for enquiries, but at present none of those questioned
persons was able to give any definite evidence as to who
fired the shots and his particulars. From enquiries made
by A.I. Section on two cartridge cases found at the scene
of shooting it was learned that the pistol used in this
shooting had been recorded as the same one used in the
fatal shooting on Route Voyron, French Concession on the
5-6-40, and the motive of which shooting is believed to
be a revenge on the part of Chinese guerrilla against
the person who previously been a guerrilla commander, but
had recently gone to the Japanese. (The extract of copy
of Police Report attached herewith).
The following information report had been recorded
pages.zh:
3/3

四川北路与吴昌路路口西南角的日本宪兵队食堂时，有人从他背后开了两枪，一颗子弹穿透其腹部射出，另一颗穿透其左胸。受伤的军官先被送往蓬路的篠崎医院（Shinojaki Hospital），随后被转送至亿普路（Y'poo Road）的日本陆军野战医院，并于1940年3月29日（原文如此，应为9月29日）晚10时50分因伤死亡。根据渡边（Tatanabe，原文拼写有误，应为Watanabe）警探在日本宪兵队总部的调查，获悉有10人因此次枪击事件被拘留审讯，其中8人在审讯后被释放，但仍有2名中国小贩被扣留接受调查。目前，受审人员中无人能提供关于开枪者及其具体情况的明确证据。根据情报科对在枪击现场发现的两枚弹壳的调查，获悉此次枪击使用的手枪与1940年6月5日在法租界福煦路（Route Voyron）发生的致命枪击案中使用的是同一把，据信那次枪击的动机是中国游击队对一名前游击队指挥官但近期投奔日本者的报复。（附上警察报告摘录副本）。
以下信息报告已由警务处长于1940年9月30日记录，涉及1940年9月29日的枪击事件。

September 30, 1940.

Secretary & Commissioner General,
S.M.C.

Shooting of Japanese Officer.

With regard to the attached report, Major
Hayashi called on me at my home at 2 a.m. and
reported the occurrence, the victim being a
Major in the Air Force.

He requested lodging house search parties
in Louza and these were carried out till 7 a.m.,
more than 20 houses being visited. He gave as
his view a desire on the part of the Blueshirts
to shoot a Gendarmerie Officer. The scene is
close to Gendarmerie Headquarters Bridge House.

He stated a hawker had been the criminal run
West on Woochang Road and only one man was be-
lieved concerned.

(Sd) K.M. Bourne
Commissioner of Police.

St. Luke's Hospital informing this station that ricksha
coolie who was accidently wounded at the time of shooting
on the night of the 29-9-40, had recovered from his injury

1940年9月30日。

工部局秘书长兼总办，

日本军官被枪击案。

关于附件报告，林少校（Major Hayashi）于凌晨2点到我家中拜访并报告了此事，受害者为空军少校。

他要求在老闸区进行寓所搜查，搜查持续至早上7点，共查访了20多处住所。他认为这是蓝衣社企图射杀一名宪兵军官的行为。案发地点靠近宪兵队总部大桥公寓（Bridge House）。

他表示罪犯是一名小贩，向西逃往吴昌路，且相信只有一人涉案。

（签名）K.M. Bourne
警务处长。

1940年10月2日，接到圣路加医院的电话留言，通知本分局，在1940年9月29日晚枪击事件中意外受伤的人力车夫已伤愈出院。

and left the hospital. Written statement of the ricksha
coolie is attached herewith.
In view of the facts mentioned above it is believed
that the case is purely of a political nature.
It is not accidental as the now deceased was in
uniform and could not be mistaken for any one else. The
terrorist or terrorists evidently were after any military
man of a high rank and the victim happened to be the first
person who had approached at the terrorist waiting spot.
The fact that the now deceased arrived to Shanghai on the
same date and was visiting many uncertain places before
proceeding to his residence, shows that he could not be
followed and was not the desired object for some personal
revenge. The scene of shooting is outside Japanese Military
canteen and in close vicinity of Japanese Gendarmerie Head-
quarters, therefore it is quite evident that same was se-
lected by terrorist as the spot where there is more
opportunity to meet a military officer as mentioned above.
Further intensive enquiries have been daily con-
ducted by detectives at the scene of shooting and vicinity
and number of people questioned, but all such enquiries
failed to locate any one who witnessed the shooting and
who could give any useful information to the enquiring
officers.

D. S. I.

鉴于上述事实，相信此案纯属政治性质。
这并非偶然事件，因为死者身着制服，不可能被误认为其他人。恐怖分子显然意在袭击任何高级别的军人，而受害者恰好是第一个接近恐怖分子埋伏地点的人。死者于同日抵达上海，并在前往住所前走访了许多不确定的地点，这一事实表明他未被跟踪，也不是个人复仇的目标。枪击现场位于日本军队食堂外，且紧邻日本宪兵队总部，因此很明显，恐怖分子选择此地是因为如上所述，在此遇到军官的机会更大。
侦探每日在枪击现场及周边进行密集的进一步调查，并讯问了多人，但所有此类调查均未能找到任何目击枪击并能向调查官员提供有用信息的人。

Koo Ts Yoang (顧芝榮).
Nantung                                C. D. C. 218.
Hongkew Stn.        30-9-40        translated      Clerk Ling.

My name is Koo Ts Yoang, age 29 years, native of
Nantung, at present residing at House No.680, Lane 506,
N. Szechuen Road.

Every day I sell cigarettes at the mouth of Lane 506,
above road.

At about 10 p.m. on 29-9-40, whilst hawking at the above
location, I suddenly heard a sound like gun-shot twice from
the direction of West Woochang Road - N. Szechuen Road. (As
I was inside of the mouth of alleyway, I could not see who
fired the shots). After this I observed a Japanese officer,
age about 50, in a manner of being injured, walking slowly
on the West side of N. Szechuen Road towards Boone Road.
(About 10 houses distance from West Woochang Road). At that
time several Japanese Gendarmes ran towards the injured
officer from the direction of N. Szechuen Road bridge, who
called for public ricksha and attempted to question the injured
officer, but suddenly the latter collapsed on the ground.
Later there came many Japanese soldiers by motor car, who
conveyed the injured officer away, and at the same time took
with them several hawkers.

At about 8 a.m. today (30-9-40) two Chinese came to the
mouth of the above alleyway and ordered me to attend the
Japanese Military Headquarters for questioning re the
occurrence. After I had told the above related particulars
I was then released at 12 noon.

The above statement is true.

(Signed and crossmarked): Koo Ts Yoang.

南通                                C. D. C. 218。
虹口分局        1940年9月30日        翻译      职员 Ling。

我叫顾芝荣，29岁，籍贯南通，现居住于四川北路506弄680号。

我每天在上述道路的506弄口售卖香烟。

1940年9月29日晚10时许，当我在上述地点叫卖时，突然听到从西吴昌路-四川北路方向传来两声类似枪响的声音。（由于我在弄堂口内侧，没看到是谁开的枪）。随后我看到一名约50岁的日本军官，呈受伤状态，在四川北路西侧缓慢向西吴昌路方向（距西吴昌路约10户人家距离）走向蓬路。当时几名日本宪兵从四川北路桥方向跑向受伤军官，他们叫了一辆公共人力车并试图询问受伤军官，但后者突然倒在地上。后来许多日本士兵乘汽车赶来，将受伤军官带走，同时带走了几名小贩。

以上陈述属实。

My name is Zau Ching Ling, age 36, m/public riosha
coolie, residing at No.12 Chun Foh Li, Woochang Road.
At about 9.30 p.m. 29-9-40, whilst I was pulling a

1940年9月29日晚9时30分许，当我在鸭绿江路桥附近拉着387号人力车时，一名中国男子雇我的车去四川北路的大英邮政总局。当我到达天潼路与四川北路路口时，我将车停在南侧。此时我听到身后一声枪响，感到左臂疼痛，同时听到另一声枪响，我的乘客也感到左耳轻微疼痛。在此期间，许多行人围住了我和乘客。随后，一名上海公共租界巡捕（S.P.C.）将我护送至虹口分局，之后我被送往圣路加医院接受治疗。关于枪击，我未目睹事发经过。

Shantung                                C.D.C. M.S.

My name is Hung Teh Yuen, age 61, watchman, residing
at 621 [涂改] on night duty at Lane 506 N. Szechuen
Road (from 7 p.m. to 7 a.m.).

At about 10 p.m. 29-9-40, while I was patrolling the
alleyway. Suddenly I heard two shots fired, I ran out of the
alleyway and saw a Japanese officer, age about 50, holding a
lighted cigarette on his hand, walking slowly at the west
pavement of N. Szechuen Road, north of Woochang Road, towards
Boone Road, before arriving to opposite side of Shing Yah
restaurant. That place being apart from Woochang Road, about
6 premises (about 100 feet). The officer in question summoned
a public ricksha with his hand, and which had not reached him
yet, while several Japanese Gendarmes stationed at N. Szechuen and
Tsungming Roads Headquarters proceeded to the scene (probably
they heard shots fired) and tried to ask the officer, but
that officer appeared to be injured and fall down on the
roadway. The officer in question then was removed away with
a m/car by the Japanese soldiers. While a fried nut hawker
was taken to Japanese Military Headquarters, from West Woochang
Road near N. Szechuen Road and 3 fruit hawkers from Lane 506
N. Szechuen Road. I did not see who actually fired the shots.

The above is my true statement.

1940年9月29日晚10时许，我正在弄堂内巡逻。突然听到两声枪响，我跑出弄堂，看到一名约50岁的日本军官，手中夹着点燃的香烟，在吴昌路以北的四川北路西侧人行道上，朝蓬路方向缓慢行走，尚未到达兴华餐厅（Shing Yah restaurant）对面。该处距离吴昌路约6个门面（约100英尺）。该军官挥手召唤一辆公共人力车，车尚未到达他身边时，几名驻守在四川北路与崇明路总部的日本宪兵赶到现场（可能是听到了枪声）并试图询问该军官，但该军官似乎受了伤，倒在马路上。随后该军官被日本士兵用汽车运走。同时，一名在西吴昌路靠近四川北路处的炒货小贩和三名来自四川北路506弄的水果小贩被带往日本军事总部。我未看到实际开枪者。

REPORT

Subject Re Search of Hotels and Lodging Houses in Louza District,
30-9-40.

Made by and Forwarded by C.I. McFarlane

Sir,

I beg to report that at 2.05 a.m. 30-9-40, the
D.C. (Divisions), Mr. H.D.M. Robertson communicated with
the undersigned by phone and stated that as there had been
an attempt made to assassinate a Japanese Military Officer
on North Szechuen Road shortly after 10 p.m. 29-9-40,
the S.M. Police had decided to search Hotels and Lodging
Houses in the Settlement in an effort to locate and
apprehend the assassin.

In order to augment the station staff, the D.C.
(Divisions) ordered out a division of the Reserve Unit
to assist.

The Reserve Unit under S.I. Goffe and officers
from the station under Inspector Boorman commenced opera-
tions at 2.30 a.m. and continued searching Hotels, etc.
until 7.45 a.m. 30-9-40 at which time, the D.C. (Divisions)
gave orders to cease.

During the times stated, the undermentioned
places were thoroughly searched.

In addition to this, D.S.I. Suhoff and Chinese
detectives questioned all likely suspects among the curfew
breakers and S.I. Harrison i/c night duties was also detail-
ed to specially go round the District with the raiding van
during the curfew hours and arrest all persons seen on
the streets. In all, 142 Chinese males and 28 females
were arrested for breaking curfew regulations whilst
34 male Chinese were brought in by S.I. Harrison.

These searches etc. were made, but no useful
results were obtained.

报告

事由：关于1940年9月30日搜查老闸区旅馆及寄宿寓所之事。

由 C.I. McFarlane 撰写并呈报

先生：

谨此报告，1940年9月30日凌晨2时05分，分区副巡官（D.C. (Divisions)）H.D.M. Robertson 先生通过电话与卑职联系，并表示由于1940年9月29日晚上10点后不久在北四川路发生了一起刺杀日本军官未遂事件，上海公共租界警务处决定搜查租界内的旅馆和寄宿寓所，以 Locate 并逮捕刺客。

为增强本捕房警力，分区副巡官（D.C. (Divisions)）命令后备队的一个分队出动协助。

由 S.I. Goffe 率领的后备队以及由 Boorman 巡官率领的本捕房警员于凌晨2时30分开始行动，持续搜查旅馆等处，直至1940年9月30日上午7时45分，此时分区副巡官（D.C. (Divisions)）下令停止行动。

在上述时间内，对下列场所进行了彻底搜查。

此外，副巡长 Suhoff 和华人侦探对所有违反宵禁的可疑人员进行了讯问，负责夜间勤务的 S.I. Harrison 也被特别指派在宵禁期间驾驶巡逻车巡视全区，逮捕所有在街上发现的人员。总计有142名华籍男性和28名女性因违反宵禁规定被捕，另有34名华籍男性由 S.I. Harrison 带回。

进行了上述搜查等行动，但未获得任何有用结果。

At 10.20 p.m. on the 29/9/40, S. P. C. 98 brought
to the station one public ricsha coolie (Japanese licen-
sed ricsha) named Lau Ching Ling (曹敬林), 36, Tungchow,
√Ricsha coolie, residing 12 Sum Foh Sun Loong, Woochang
Road, whom he found on N. Szechuen Road near Tiendong Rd.
suffering from a bullet wound on his left arm. The coolie
was immediately dispatched to the St. Luke's Hospital
where on being examined by the hospital doctor the follow-
ing certificate has been issued:-
"Gun shot wound on left hand arm.
May become serious".
Detained in the hospital.
Enquiries made by C. D. C. 318 and the undersigned
learned that at about 10.10 p.m. on the 29/9/40, the above
mentioned ricsha coolie was pulling his ricsha occupied
by a male Chinese passenger South along N. Szechuen Road
and when approaching Tiendong Road his left arm was hit
by a bullet which passed through the flesh of his arm
making two holes just above the elbow. The coolie stated
that he heard the sounds of two distant shots at the time
from the direction of Woochang Road. During the course of
enquiries at 10.30 p.m. above date a telephone message

一名不明身份华籍男子在北四川路近吴淞路处枪击并致一名日本军官重伤。

1940年9月29日晚上10时20分，特别巡捕 98号 (S. P. C. 98) 将一名名叫曹敬林 (Lau Ching Ling)、36岁、通州人、√黄包车夫、居住在吴淞路三福新里12号的公共黄包车夫（持有日本执照的黄包车）带到捕房。该捕房是在北四川路近天潼路处发现他的，其左臂受枪伤。该车夫立即被送往圣路加医院 (St. Luke's Hospital)，经医院医生检查后，出具了以下证明：
“左手臂枪伤。
可能恶化”。
留院观察。
经华人侦探主任 318号 (C. D. C. 318) 和卑职调查得知，1940年9月29日晚上10时10分左右，上述黄包车夫拉着载有一名华籍男乘客的黄包车，沿北四川路向南行驶，当接近天潼路时，他的左臂被子弹击中，子弹穿过手臂肌肉，在肘部上方打出两个洞。该车夫称，当时他听到从吴淞路方向传来两声遥远的枪响。在上述日期的晚上10时30分调查过程中，收到一条电话消息

pages.en:
1/2

was received from J.N...P. Headquarters informing the
Police (through Japanese Office) that a shooting affray
had taken place on N. Szechuen Road near Woochang Road
and that one Japanese Military Officer was wounded.
On receiving the above message C.D.C. 318, D.P.S.
Aosomoto and the undersigned proceeded to above location
and found that joint enquiries being already conducted
at the scene by J.N.L.P. Japanese Gendarmerie and Japanese
Consular Police and from above authorities it was learned
that at about 10.10 p.m. 29/3/40 an unknown male Chinese
fired two shots from a pistol (believed to be a Mauser
pistol) at Japanese Military Officer (name and rank not
disclosed) who was proceeding at the time North along N.
Szechuen Road walking by footpath on West side of the road
and crossing Woochang Road.
Further it was learned that the officer who was
wounded had been dispatched to the Japanese Military
Hospital, Kiangwan, where he died at 10.50 p.m. even date.
It was also learned from above authorities that the
Chinese who fired shots made good his escape running
West along Woochang Road (the road at that section being
not lighted).
The following precautionary measures were taken
by Japanese Authorities during the course of enquiry.
pages.zh:
1/2

来自日本海军陆战队警察局 (J.N...P.) 总部，通过日本办事处通知警方，北四川路近吴淞路处发生枪击事件，一名日本军官受伤。
收到上述消息后，华人侦探主任 318号、副巡官 Aosomoto 和卑职前往上述地点，发现日本海军陆战队警察局 (J.N.L.P.)、日本宪兵队和日本领事馆警察已经在现场进行联合调查，从上述当局处获悉，1940年9月29日（原文误写为3月）晚上10时10分左右，一名不明身份华籍男子用手枪（据信为毛瑟手枪）向一名日本军官（姓名和军衔未披露）开了两枪，当时该军官正沿北四川路西侧人行道步行向北，穿越吴淞路。
此外还获悉，受伤军官已被送往江湾日本军医院，并于当晚晚上10时50分死亡。
另从上述当局处获悉，开枪的华人沿吴淞路向西逃跑脱身（该路段当时没有路灯）。
在调查过程中，日本当局采取了以下预防措施。

pages.en:
1/3

The whole section inside of Chapoo, Boone, N.
Kiangse and N. Soochow Roads was cordoned by member of
J. M. L. Party and all Chinese pedestrians were subjects
of search parties. The Szechuen Road Bridge was closed
for Chinese pedestrians whilst Garden and Chapoo Road
Bridges were closed for incoming Chinese pedestrians.

Inquiries show that the shooting took place
outside Japanese Gendarmerie Head quarters canteen
situated at the South, West corner of N. Szechuen and
Chapoo roads intersection and that two empty cartridges
were found at the scene by members of J. M. L. P. and who
requested S. M. P. to have same examined by A. I. Section
on the morning of the 30/9/40 when the same will be handed
over to D. S. I. Watanabe. It appears that several street
hawkers had been detained by J. M. L. P. authorities for
questioning as they were found in vicinity of the scene
of the shooting and quitepossibly witnessed the occur-
rence. No more details were obtained by enquiring officer
from Japanese Authorities conducting investigations and
the motive of that shooting is not known at present.

Enquiries proceeding.

Circulated.

D. O. "C" Division and D. D. O. informed.

乍浦路、蓬路、北江西路和北苏州路以内的整个区域由日本海军陆战队 (J. M. L.) 队员封锁，所有中国行人均成为搜查对象。四川路桥禁止中国行人通行，而花园桥和乍浦路桥则禁止进入的中国行人通行。

调查显示，枪击发生在位于北四川路和乍浦路交叉口西南角的日本宪兵队总部食堂外，日本海军陆战队警察局 (J. M. L. P.) 成员在现场发现了两枚空弹壳，并要求上海公共租界警务处 (S. M. P.) 鉴识科于1940年9月30日上午进行检验，届时将移交给副巡长 Watanabe。看来有几名街头小贩被日本海军陆战队警察局 (J. M. L. P.) 当局拘留讯问，因为他们出现在枪击现场附近，很可能目睹了事发经过。负责调查的警官从负责调查的日本当局处未获得更多细节，目前尚不清楚此次枪击的动机。
